AccountDisplayIdentity.description: The non-secret identity a host may render for one installed Account.

AccountUnlockCapabilities.description:
Core-supported Account unlock actions. Biometric eligibility retains its dedicated projection.
Desktop authorization may require opening or reconnecting Desktop before its explicit ceremony.

failure.description: None means the explicitly requested Account unlocked successfully.

CrossAccountMoveResumeGuard.description: Stateless stale-input evidence. Both Accounts and current Server authority are still checked.

DeviceSetupDisclosure.description: Transient setup disclosure: never part of an observation or persisted projection.

EditableItemDraft.description: A normal Create or Update cannot submit a credential, even if the caller forges JSON.

EditableLoginItemData.description: Ordinary callers can edit the Login fields shown in the UI, never its credential array.

ImportItemDraft.description:
One plaintext Import draft. The host supplies only category data and Favorite; Rust owns the
final Item identity, ciphertext, and immutable batch request.

ItemDuplicateGuard.description:
Selection evidence for same-Vault Duplicate. This names either one confirmed Item version
or one exact locally accepted encrypted overlay, never a synthetic confirmed authority row.

ItemEditGuard.description: Stateless evidence of the authoritative Item version the caller actually edited.

MyTeamInvitation.description: Only authenticated pending Invitations addressed to this User are projected.

ObservationControl.description: Nonplaintext terminal controls bypass revoked plaintext delivery tokens.

attemptCount.description: Terminal receipts do not retain historical scheduling diagnostics.

OperationsProjection.description: Non-secret progress from accepted Operations and their durable terminal receipts.

PublicItemDraft.description: The ordinary Item surface. Credential metadata is visible, but signing material is not.

PublicLoginItemData.description: Ordinary callers can edit the Login fields shown in the UI, never its credential array.

publicKeyFingerprint.description: Stale-selection evidence over the exact persisted public-key String, not a trust root.

RecoveryBound.description: Closed recovery implementation guards; these are not Account capacity limits.

RuntimeOutcome.description:
The declared envelope every external Runtime request answers with.

Serde would otherwise emit its externally tagged `Result` spelling, an implicit wire shape no
contract describes. This adjacent tagging matches `RuntimeProjection`, and it keeps the
success payload intact: `RuntimeResponse` is itself internally tagged on `type`, so an
internally tagged envelope would collide with it.

oneOf.description:
Retires this Account's live keys and plaintext delivery while the Device keeps the
material one master password reopens.

Ends local ownership: the same retirement as `Lock`, and the Device forgets the
Quick Unlock material and Session, so this Account needs a full Sign-in again.
Irreversibly removes exactly the explicitly named Account from this Device.

Uses this installed Account's Runtime-owned Session to request authoritative Server
deletion. The host retains the exact request identity until the workflow is closed.
Irreversibly removes every Runtime-owned Account and Device record.
The Server confirmed acceptance, but Core has not installed fresh Vault authority.
A lost reply never proves a mutation's result, even when later reads show absence.

The Account access state this Device holds after a `Lock` or `SignOut`. An Account this
Device does not have answers `SignedOut`, because that is what it is.

TeamLeaveAttempt.description: A nonterminal Team-leave attempt already owned by this Account's Replica journal.

TeardownPhase.description: Closed, bounded failure vocabulary. It deliberately carries no host detail or identity.

TravelModePolicy.description: Presentation of verified durable metadata; timestamps retain decimal millisecond wire values.

VaultExportProjection.description: Plaintext only the foreground, scoped Export loan can deliver.

VaultProjection.description: One Vault as an Items reader needs it: enough to label it and to know what may be written.

role.description:
This Account's membership in the Vault. A host derives "may I write an Item here"
from it (anything but `ReadOnly`), and the manage affordances an Owner or Admin has
and a Member does not. The first slice's narrower create rule filters on the Vault
type as well.

VaultProjectionRole.description:
One Account's membership in one Vault.

The values are the Server's own closed `VaultRole` set, spelled the way the Server spells
them, so a host that already renders a role does not need a second vocabulary and a
translation table between the two.

WritableVaultProjection.description: Non-secret authority metadata for every currently unlocked writable Vault on this Device.
